description: This file defines the interface and class structure for a media component in Android's Codec2 HAL, including class 'Component' with methods for media processing, surface management, and component lifecycle.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Represents a media component with methods for media processing, surface management, and lifecycle control, implementing the IComponent interface.

methods.name: Component
methods.description: Constructor initializing the media component with necessary dependencies.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the component.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Queues a work bundle for processing.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the component's buffers.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains the component, optionally with end-of-stream.

methods.name: setOutputSurface
methods.description: Sets the output surface for rendering.

methods.name: connectToInputSurface
methods.description: Connects to an input surface.

methods.name: connectToOmxInputSurface
methods.description: Connects to an OMX input surface.

methods.name: disconnectFromInputSurface
methods.description: Disconnects from the input surface.

methods.name: createBlockPool
methods.description: Creates a block pool for buffer management.

methods.name: destroyBlockPool
methods.description: Destroys a specified block pool.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts component processing.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops component processing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the component state.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the component resources.

methods.name: getInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the component interface.

methods.name: asInputSink
methods.description: Returns the component as an input sink.

methods.name: configureVideoTunnel
methods.description: Configures video tunneling.

methods.name: setOutputSurfaceWithSyncObj
methods.description: Sets output surface with synchronization object.

methods.name: findLocalComponent
methods.description: Finds a local C2Component associated with a sink.
